name: GitHub

free_tier.notes: Private repos on standard GitHub-hosted runners; unlimited/free for public repos and self-hosted runners. Larger runners always billed.
Shared between Actions artifacts and GitHub Packages; Actions cache is separately 10 GB per repository.
Personal accounts only; e.g. 60 hours on a 2-core machine. Org/enterprise plans include no free Codespaces quota.
Pages hosting itself is free; public repos only on the Free plan (private-repo Pages needs Pro+).
Does not apply when publishing via a custom GitHub Actions workflow.

notes: Perpetual free tier (GitHub Free plan), not a trial. Actions minutes quota applies only to private repos on standard runners; public repos are free without a minutes cap. Codespaces free quota exists only for personal accounts; unused quota does not roll over, and without a payment method usage stops at the free quota. No credit card needed to sign up for GitHub Free.
